#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
cd "$DIR/host"
exec dotnet run --project src/Csdesk.Host -c Release -- --team-dir "$DIR" "$@"
